sections.section_title: EXTI CPU wake-up with event mask register 3 (EXTI_EMR3)
sections.text_helper: Section 25.7.32 "EXTI CPU wake-up with event mask register 3 (EXTI_EMR3)" in chapter 25 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1164.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0A4
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:14 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)
Bit 13 EM77: CPU wake-up with event on event input 77
0: Wake-up with event request from line x is masked.
1: Wake-up with event request from line x is unmasked.
l When SECx is disabled in EXTI_SECCFGR3, EMx can be accessed with non-secure and
secure access.
l When SECx is enabled in EXTI_SECCFGR3, EMx can be accessed only with secure
access. Nonsecure write to EMx is discarded. Nonsecure read returns 0.
l When PRIVx is disabled in EXTI_PRIVCFGR3, EMx can be accessed with privileged and
unprivileged access.
l When PRIVx is enabled in EXTI_PRIVCFGR3, EMx can be accessed only with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to EMx is discarded, and read returns 0.
Bits 12:11 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 10:4 EMx: CPU wake-up with interrupt mask on event input x (x = 74 to 68)
Bit 3 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 2:0 EMx: CPU wake-up with interrupt mask on event input x (x = 66 to 64)
Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)
